body: A1 AGREE (+narrowing chem-gas Na diff -9/-8/-6/-4 supportive only; TG not same-time). A2 AGREE (arterial/venous unknown, minor). A3 AGREE (one correction; constructs). A4 AGREE: DKA moderate by HCO3, not HHS/mixed; no 0.45% indication. B(i) PARTIAL: K not a resolution criterion but replete toward 4-5 and check Mg around transition; pausing running infusion = clinical judgement. B(ii) AGREE: overlap timing does not change K q2h then q4h monitoring; ADA2026 2 h vs 2-4 h internal inconsistency; Toujeo U300 onset ~6 h/steady state >=5 d (US) 3-4 d (EU). B(iii) AGREE: no MAR, no claim of administration.
